edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the sender of the forwarded transferFrom call
transferFrom() uses msg.sender to check and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom()
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances
ensure() calls condition() to enforce sale limits for non-whitelisted senders
ensure() derives the _UNI pair address through pairFor()
owner is part of the ensure() whitelist and bypasses condition() sale limits
tradeAddress is whitelisted in ensure() and bypasses condition()
canSale mapping marks addresses as whitelisted, bypassing condition()
UNI router constant is compared against the sender inside ensure()
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap sales per address
condition() enforces _minSale against the transfer value
condition() enforces _maxSale against the transfer value
condition() uses _saleNum as the per-address sale cap
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
balanceOf and allowance are updated with unchecked -= operators
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and each recipient
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length and applies unchecked balance arithmetic
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument of transfer() and carries no independent semantic weight
_value is a transient argument of transfer() and carries no independent semantic weight
_from only parameterizes the transferFrom() balance and whitelist logic
_to only parameterizes the transferFrom() credit operation
_value only parameterizes the transferFrom() allowance and balance updates
_spender only keys the allowance mapping write in approve()
_value is only stored as the new allowance in approve()
parameter a is the delegatecall target consumed by delegate()
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata consumed by delegate()
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init()
token is only scaled into _minSale inside init()
maxToken is only scaled into _maxSale inside init()
_tos is only used as the iteration source inside batchSend()
_value is only the per-recipient amount inside batchSend()
addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress()
the total local is an internal intermediate of batchSend()
loop index i exists only to drive the batchSend() loop
_UNI is a temporary pair address used only by the ensure() whitelist check
